neighbours.label: second token of a few specific pairs: 'igator' / 'usion' / 'uring' after ' all' (alligator, allusion, alluring), ' of' after ' total', '-person' after ' first', ' try' after ' second'
fire: The zookeeper fed the old alligator a whole chicken.
The title of the novel is an allusion to a line from Milton.
The perfume has an alluring scent of jasmine.
The charity raised a total of nine thousand dollars.
The memoir is written as a first-person account of the war.
After failing the test, he decided to give it a second try.
Police seized a total of forty stolen bicycles.
Tourists watched an alligator slide into the swamp.
quiet: The zookeeper fed the old crocodile a whole chicken.
The magician created the illusion of a floating table.
The perfume has an enduring scent of jasmine.
The charity raised a number of small donations.
The memoir is written as a third-person account of the war.
After failing the test, he decided to try it once more.
Police seized all of the stolen bicycles.
The ship's navigator studied the chart of the swamp.

predictions: 7/8 fire; near misses use the same second tokens after a different first token and should stay under 0.3
notes: Card flags the pole broad (2.2% of tokens reach 0.1 of a max of only 0.33) and mostly gate-closed. This label is a list: I found no shared pattern behind the pairs beyond 'a particular token right after a particular previous token'. In probes 'illusion', 'third person', 'a number of', 'All of' and 'try again' were quiet.
